label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (ssrf) alert-TP: User input 'param' from request.getParameter('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to 'host' variable, which is used in openUrlByHostname(host) at line 45 to construct outbound HTTPS URL. Although isNonPublicAddress(addr) check exists, it only validates specific address types (loopback/site-local/link-local/any-local) and does not comprehensively block all SSRF vectors (cloud metadata endpoints, internal services with public IPs, DNS rebinding windows). Resolved sink value at line 45 is 'host' = user-controlled param, which remains attacker-controllable despite partial mitigation.

evidence.note: User param flows to host, then openUrlByHostname(host) makes outbound connection
Sink: openUrlByHostname(host) uses user-controlled host in URL construction
